Compound: **nocodazole** (PubChem CID [4122](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/4122))

## Reflection

The call was correct because multiple independent readouts converged: unanimous atlas match (10/10 Microtubule destabilizers), very high act_tub_ratio z=+32 to +44 from dim diffuse tubulin, and lobulated nuclei with nuc_solidity z=-20 to -35 replicating at 0.3, 1.0 and 3 uM.
